subject: [PATCH v5 13/22] ext2: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the ext2 file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using a macro that wraps the iomap_iter_next() helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and only updates the internal implementation of the iomap operations. The goal of this conversion is likely to prepare the ext2 file system for future changes or improvements related to iomap operations.
